correctness.rationale: For Y_n=C_n □ K_2, n>=3, independent inspection of the third-edge definition yields the exact local conflict table among top edges T_i, bottom B_i and spokes S_i. For every column i, both {T_i,B_i,S_(i+2)} and {T_i,B_i,S_(i-1)} are pairwise-conflicting triples, and each family partitions the 3n edges. Therefore any EOP selects at most n edges. At equality both triple covers are exactly saturated, hence s_(i+3)=s_i. Adjacent spokes conflict, forcing either no spokes (which makes a prohibited whole horizontal layer) or one occupied mod-3 spoke class; consecutive horizontal pairs use the same layer and successive pairs must alternate, forcing 2 | (n/3). For 6|n exactly three spoke shifts times two starting layers give six valid maximum sets in one automorphism orbit. The explicit 6-periodic templates and mod-6 seam checks construct n-1 EOPs in every other residue, with separate n=3 witness. Independent literal endpoint-bridge construction confirmed witnesses n=3..34 and exact conflict-graph optimum n=3..10, obtaining 2,3,4,6,6,7,8,9; finite tests are not the all-n proof.
residual_risks: Six-fold extremizer census is claimed only when 6 divides n; no census of n-1 maxima.
The n=3 triangle layer has wraparound coincidences handled independently.

originality.rationale: Brešar–Samadi Theorem 4.1 (2024) already characterizes graphs saturating |E|/minimum-degree; on cubic prisms this implies an n upper-bound and may yield the existence part of 6|n after specializing structural hypotheses, and this prior implication is expressly acknowledged. It does not yield the exact n-1 deficit for every remaining residue, the explicit witnesses, or exactly six labeled extremizers. Brešar et al. 2024 Cartesian-product inequalities and prism vertex 3-packing bounds have different statements; known injective edge chromatic indices concern partition count, not the maximum cardinality and count of one EOP class. No matching all-n theorem located via Resultary or indexed exact aliases.
residual_risks: General 2024 equality theorem may already imply saturation iff n is a multiple of six after specialized structural work; novelty is the exact five nonsaturation residues, witnesses and extremizer census.
Earlier injective-edge-coloring literature might describe exactly the same six configurations under a different notion.

value.rationale: For a basic, natural infinite graph product, the EOP maximum exhibits a genuine arithmetic period-six defect from the universal cubic bound. The sharp all-residue value, explicit n-1 witnesses and unique six-element orbit of saturated extremizers identify a structural packing rigidity phenomenon rather than a mechanical rephrasing of the universal bound. The six-periodic classification is a plausible reference for future studies of edge packings and injective color classes.
residual_risks: Only six saturation optima are classified; for n not divisible by six no enumeration of all size n-1 subsets is claimed.

scientific_limitations: n>=3 (C3 triangle); all graphs undirected simple.
Equality multiplicity claim applies only if 6|n; remaining residue result is numeric maximum and constructive.
